data.body:
[P2] Recover accepted executions during per-case teardown

The pytest fixture calls `close_case()` directly, bypassing the discovery added to `settle_run()`. If Invoke is accepted but its response is lost, the item retains its marker without an ARN and this loop skips it, even when the execution appears in the service's running list. `quiesce()` only observes that unfinished execution; it never stops it, so it can exhaust the drain budget and prevent subsequent lifecycle cases. Resolve invoked markers through `load_markers()` before stopping executions, and add a lost-response regression that exercises `close_case()` directly.
